notes: Georgia has no state Renewable Portfolio Standard. GA-generated RECs sell voluntarily / bilaterally, typically to the hosting customer for their own ESG reporting. For real compliance-market SREC pricing, deploy pods in PJM states (VA, PA, MD, NJ, OH, IL, DC, DE) or ERCOT (TX).

psc.applicableAbove_MW: hyperscale-scale (sub-5 MW pods on standard commercial tariffs)

salesTaxExemption.reason: Sub-5 MW pods never met minimum-investment threshold; treat exemption as upside if it survives, not a base-case assumption.

itcSprint.notes: Solar must reach commercial operation by 12/31/2027 to earn ITC. Storage ITC survives beyond that. Modular pod schedule (90-day install) makes the deadline achievable.
